assertions.name: no_q0_flip
assertions.source: every witness's q0Value must match its q0Anchor's canonical pin

description: Flip-flop detector: enforces that each witness's q0Value matches the canonical pin for its q0Anchor (muon vs proton). Q0_FLIP is a CI-failing anchor/value disagreement. Anchor recording landed in PR #4020. Q0_INDEPENDENT records a producer that never reads q₀ at all — a positive, producer-declared statement, distinct from Q0_AMBIGUOUS (depends on q₀, pin undetermined) and from Q0_ANCHOR_MISSING (nothing recorded).

Q0_INDEPENDENT_NO_REASON.detail: anchor=independent with no q0AnchorReason — states that q₀ is never read, but not why, so the claim cannot be checked without re-deriving the import cone
